GOOD_NEIGHBOR_LOSS: Count distinct region IDs delivered at publication/worker boundary with quality ACCEPTED AND provenance CERTIFIED missing at ANY required downstream stage.
BAD_REGION_LEAK: Count distinct nonpublishable or unknown region IDs observed at ANY searchable stage.
CERTIFIER_RECALL_MISS: Author-intended GOOD with frozen actual quality UNRESOLVED. Intent-relative mismatch, not a source-quality determination.
SOURCE_PRESERVATION_FAIL: Nonpublishable boundary regions without available visual source.
partial_page_searchable: At least one ACCEPTED+CERTIFIED region survives all required searchable stages AND another same-page region is nonpublishable.
type_1: Declared internal classification -> actual publication, worker, pipeline, chunk builder; deterministic I/O doubles.
type_2: Raw source -> actual certifier -> publication -> worker; derive worker expectations from frozen actual certifier verdicts, never author intent.
negative_controls: accepted missing at each downstream stage
